verdict.rationale: The evidence covers seller onboarding, payout management, dispute monitoring and generic webhooks. Nothing documents per-sub-merchant fraud or credit-risk signals, alerts on anomalous sellers, or explicit tools to pause payouts or offboard sellers. Generic payout management and dispute handling are adjacent features, not portfolio risk monitoring, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can watch risk across my seller portfolio — fraud and credit-risk signals per sub-merchant, alerts on anomalous sellers, and tools to pause payouts or offboard bad actors
